Ventis D450 Pro · Technical data sheet
Balanced ventilation unit with heat recovery for new and renovated homes.
| Feature | Value |
| - | - |
| Maximum air flow | 450 m3/h |
| Heat recovery efficiency | 94 % |
| Sound power level | 28 dB(A) |
| Supply air filter | ISO ePM1 70 % (F9) |
| Weight | 52 kg |
| Dimensions (H x W x D) | 860 x 640 x 360 mm |
| Energy class | A+ |
Warranty: 5 years on the compressor, 2 years on other parts.
context: Cette section présente les caractéristiques techniques et les conditions de garantie de la ventilation double flux Ventis D450 Pro.
